credits.title: FING!
credits.overview: Myrtle's parents will do anything to make her happy, even track down a strange creature in a remote jungle. But when a greedy wildlife park owner takes the rare Fing, the family must pull off a daring rescue to save their magical friend.

credits.title: Chromatic
credits.overview: In a world where at 18, blood color defines societal value, three siblings await the day the Chromacy dictates their future. When Lucas's blood reveals a shocking truth, their fate takes a dark turn, forcing them into a fight for survival.

credits.title: Searching for Daisies
credits.overview: In a rural neighbourhood, two naive, nine-year-old children meet over their shared fence... a talkative, ill-fated foster child, Daisy... and a dorky, delicate home schooler, Levi. The pair form an unlikely bond and together embark on a risky adventure to return Daisy home.
